definition_en: The ability to understand how different parts of a system interact, identify feedback loops, and recognise how changes in one area affect the whole.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk memahami bagaimana bahagian-bahagian dalam sesuatu sistem saling berinteraksi, mengenal pasti gelung maklum balas, dan menyedari kesan perubahan terhadap keseluruhan sistem.
typical_tasks_en:
• Map how delayed supplier payments affect inventory, staffing, and customer satisfaction.
• Model the flow of patients from registration to discharge to find bottlenecks.
• Predict how a price change in one product category might impact overall store traffic.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Petakan bagaimana kelewatan bayaran pembekal menjejaskan inventori, kakitangan dan kepuasan pelanggan.
• Model aliran pesakit daripada pendaftaran hingga discaj untuk mencari kesesakan.
• Ramalkan bagaimana perubahan harga dalam satu kategori produk mungkin menjejaskan trafik kedai keseluruhan.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires understanding interactions between multiple components
• The task involves identifying feedback loops or cascading effects
• The task requires seeing the big picture rather than isolated parts
• The task involves mapping or modelling complex processes
• The task requires predicting unintended consequences of changes
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only a single, isolated step or component
• The user executes tasks without understanding broader context
• The task requires no consideration of interdependencies
• The user follows a linear procedure without seeing systemic connections
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task involves a single isolated step with no interdependency or cascading effect described.

confusions.boundary_rule: Systems thinking sees interconnections. Analytical thinking breaks down evidence.
confusions.example_task: Analyse why delays in procurement cascade into missed deliveries.

confusions.boundary_rule: Systems thinking understands interactions. Resource management allocates specific resources.
confusions.example_task: Redesign the patient flow to reduce waiting time across departments.
confusions.expected_labels: Systems thinking; Resource management and operations

confusions.boundary_rule: Systems thinking can model environmental systems, but environmental stewardship is specifically about sustainability responsibility.
confusions.example_task: Map how packaging choices affect waste, cost, and brand reputation.
